supported_domain.contigs: Literal autosomes 1-22; explicit verified aliases for reference lookup only.
supported_domain.variants: One concrete SNV or anchored one-base insertion/deletion followed by <NON_REF>.
supported_domain.reference_blocks: One-base REF with inclusive END; source gaps remain unknown.
supported_domain.phase: Exact source preservation, including independent PGT/GT, separators, PID, PS, missing and partial genotypes.

compression.preservation: Decompression must equal original source bytes, including headers, record text and line endings.

index.evidence: Actual index creation and indexed selection at every record anchor, inside nontrivial reference blocks, and in uncovered gaps when present. Query output is evidence only.
index.executor_binding: Hash bytes copied from one stable opened regular file, seal the bounded snapshot against write/grow/shrink, verify its sealed digest and use that descriptor for every version/index/query launch. Recheck the original executable identity before promotion.
index.runtime_requirements: Linux memfd_create, immutable WRITE/GROW/SHRINK/SEAL support and /proc/self/fd access are required; no pathname-execution fallback.

reference.validation: Actual stable FASTA bytes, digest, length and requested REF spans. Ignore adjacent FASTA indexes; preserve input CHROM aliases.

artifact_promotion: Both BGZF and CSI artifacts are returned together only after all seven predicates and integrity guards pass. Failure returns no artifacts.

provenance.ledger: One source ordinal and record SHA to one retained ordinal and record SHA; zero dropped records.

license: Independent implementation of public format requirements and independently constructed synthetic records. Existing qualified bcftools MIT/Expat build reused without redistribution; GSL, Perl and plugins disabled. No third-party implementation, prose or fixture bytes included.
known_issues: Qualification is limited to the declared synthetic subset; no actual GATK caller execution or full gVCF compatibility claim.
This operation preserves artifacts; it does not normalize alleles, transform likelihoods, perform joint genotyping, infer calls, establish callability or support scientific negative findings.
Reference-block concordance checks the REF anchor and bounds; it does not prove every base through END is callable.
Unsupported INFO content, alternate callers, multiple samples, non-autosomal domains, additional concrete ALTs and general indels are rejected.
No default pipeline activation, interpretation, reporting, clinical use or release authorization.
The maximum 600-second deadline is cooperative. Blocking regular-file I/O, process creation, post-kill reaping and cleanup may overrun it; observed expiry prevents artifact promotion.
disable_path: Explicit module invocation only. Do not select this execution profile; no automatic fallback.
